summary: Two churches in a network of parishes: Our Lady Queen of Peace and its mission church St. Margaret of Cortona. The Network Mass Schedule, the Saturday Reconciliation and the First Saturday Devotion (exposition, Rosary, Benediction, Mass) are the same in all four bulletins read. Masses and Confession at St. Madeleine Sophie and St. Gabriel are other parishes' and left out. No open questions.
